name: Sub Account Identification 6
definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

ActivityIndicator.name: Activity Indicator
ActivityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is activity reported in the statement.

TransactionOnSubAccount.name: Transaction On Sub Account
TransactionOnSubAccount.definition: Creation/cancellation of investment units on the books of the fund or its designated agent, as a result of executing an investment fund order.

TransactionOnSubAccountRule.definition: If ActivityIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TransactionOnSubAccount must be present. If ActivityIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then TransactionOnSubAccount is not allowed.
